links.outcome: Speech recognition word error rate before vs after fine-tuning on local Singaporean English data
links.effect: Word error rate fell from 17.83% to 9.81% for letters and from 2.76% to 1.97% for numbers after fine-tuning on local data.
links.quote: The fine-tuned model reduced word error rates from 17.83% to 9.81% for letters and 2.76% to 1.97% for numbers.

screen.reason: The study develops and prospectively validates an AI-based system (Whisper speech recognition and computer vision pose estimation) for self-administered visual acuity testing among 72 real patients in a tertiary eye clinic.
